parameters.name: Collections
parameters.description: The collections to which the model belongs. You can specify multiple collections. Separate them with commas (,).

parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description: The domain. This parameter is used to filter the model list by domain. Examples: nlp (natural language processing) and cv (computer vision).

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: The label string. This parameter is used to filter the list. Models are returned if their label keys or values contain the specified string.

parameters.name: ModelName
parameters.description: The model name. This parameter is used to filter the model list.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The order in which to sort the results of a paged query. The default value is ASC.

- ASC: ascending order.

- DESC: descending order.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: The model source. This parameter is used to filter the model list by community or organization. Examples: ModelScope and HuggingFace.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the model list. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of models to display on each page in a paged query. The default value is 10.

parameters.name: Provider
parameters.description: The provider. If you specify a provider, only the public models from that provider are returned. If you leave this parameter empty, your own models are returned.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: The query condition. This parameter performs a fuzzy match on ModelName, Domain, Task, LabelKey, and LabelValue. For example, if you enter nlp, models that match in any of these fields are returned.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The field to use for sorting in a paged query. Currently, only the GmtCreateTime field is supported.

parameters.name: Task
parameters.description: The task. This parameter is used to filter the model list by task type. Example: text-classification.

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace ID. The returned list contains only the models in the specified workspace. For more information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~).
